title: Frontier budget: 53-65 percent frontier token share per mission window
subject: frontier-budget
ratio: Frontier-tier (fable/opus) raw-token share across the coordinator session plus all subagent transcripts targets 53-65 percent per mission window, measured by .harness/bin/token_share.py (dedup by message.id; exit 2 above band). A breach is a mandatory finding at the next section 5A audit, not a hard stop. The coordinator emits decisions, dispatch prompts and join syntheses, and delegates drafting and bulk analysis to sonnet-tier agents: the P-030 delegation duty.
dicta: The band is an OPERATOR HEURISTIC, top revised 60 to 65 the same day it was set (2026-07-11), not literature-derived: a corpus sweep found no canonical frontier/cheap split. BELOW-BAND FINDING: the share has read below band for two consecutive epics - 33.8 percent raw / 42.0 percent output at T-375, and 35.1 / 43.5 at its verdict, against the 53-65 band; the operator ordered the origin analysis (organic efficiency versus artifact) at the gen-6 audit (T-375 ruling item 10); the below-band state is a finding to explain, not a breach, since exit 2 fires only above band. Tier 2 on the P-030 accepted_mutations entry, human-directed (operator 2026-07-11, measured corpus about 80 percent raw tokens frontier); operator provenance lives here in dicta per CD6. Storage homes cost_policy.frontier_budget and cost_policy.rules entries 1 and 2 are subsumed by this record (CD8). Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-15.
